events.verdict: Barnes (DAL) briefly extends his arm into Jackson (DET) while setting the pick.
Jackson (DAL) makes marginal contact with Jackson (DET) that does not affect his SQBR.
Drummond (DET) is firming up and sets a legal pick on Brunson (DAL).
Kleber (DAL) makes contact to the body of Jackson (DET) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] Barnes (DAL) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Kleber (DAL) briefly places two hands on Griffin (DET) off ball. Griffin's reaction is not consistent with the level of contact.
Powell (DAL) intentional kicks the basketball on the play.
[Observable in enhanced video] Jackson (DET) slides his pivot foot prior prior to the release of the dribble.
Powell (DAL) cleanly blocks Griffin's (DET) shot attempt.
Drummond (DET) moves laterally into Barnes (DAL) and affects his SQBR.
Kleber (DAL) and Drummond (DET) briefly engage and disengage with one another after the pick.
Powell (DAL) delivers marginal contact with Jackson (DET) during the pick.
Powell (DAL) makes marginal contact with Griffin (DET) in the post.
Powell (DAL) makes contact to the body of Griffin (DET) after the release that does not affect his shot attempt.
LLB shows Barnes (DAL) gathers the ball and comes to a legal jump stop. He then legally lifts his foot and replants it, followed by lifting his pivot foot on the shot attempt.
Powell (DAL) commits a take foul on Jackson (DET).
Powell (DAL) commits a take foul on Jackson (DET).
[Observable in enhanced video] Barnes (DAL) slides his pivot foot.
Jackson (DET) and Broekhoff (DAL) makes incidental contact with one another during the rebound.
Griffin (DET) commits a take foul on Brunson (DAL).
Harris (DAL) loses possession after Powell (DAL) deflects the basketball away, any contact from Brown (DET) to Harris' arm is deemed incidental.
Brunson (DAL) commits a take foul on Drummond (DET).
Griffin (DET) briefly places two hands on Powell (DAL) off ball.
